messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: region-health-anomaly for service=api-runtime observed. eu-central-1 p99 > 750ms for 6m and healthcheck-failures spike. Paging: @nate. Details: https://status.redwood.ai/alerts/2155667890 :rotating_light:

nate: taking this. first pass: is this regional infra or a routing policy flapping? priya, tom you free to help?

priya: on it. checking LB and mesh controlplane. Seeing surge of 502s from envoy in eu-central-1 and a correlated drop in instance readiness. No autoscaler events.

ops-bot: automated note: recent deploys in eu cluster at 21:04 UTC by deploy-bot. Rollout status: 100% but with 10% of pods restarting once.

nate: good catch. start mitigation plan: 1) remove canary label from last rollout to stop traffic to new pods, 2) open fractional failover to other EU region (eu-west-1) at 25%, 3) silence noisy cache-miss alerts in eu-central for 15m.

priya: command to remove canary label:
```
kubectl -n services label deploy/api-runtime release=canary-
```
Applying now.


tom: adding fractional route rule to router config:
```
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/routes -d '{"service":"api-runtime","fractional_failover":{"region":"eu-west-1","percent":25}}'
```
Applied at 2155668110.

emily: creating ephemeral dashboard panel in /dashboards/region-failover to track: p99_by_region, qps_shift, pod_restarts, kv_hit_rate. Link: /dashboards/region-failover#2155668125

priya: KV hit-rate in eu-central dropped from 92% -> 63% around 21:06 UTC. That will amplify p99. We should prime cache on failover targets.

nate: trigger cache-warmers to eu-west-1. ops-bot, run the cache-priming job.

ops-bot: cache-warming job queued (job-id cw-2155668160). Running against eu-west-1. ETA ~90s.

paul: CS note: two customers reported slow responses (cust-C, cust-D). No errors, just timeouts for some long requests. I've posted an update to the incident channel and notified account leads.

nate: mitigation update: after fractional failover and cache-warming p99 in eu-central dropped from 810ms -> 430ms in ~3m. qps shifted ~22% to eu-west-1. Good.

emily: created a temporary suppression rule: suppress alert 'cache-miss-eu-central' for 15m with meta reason=failover. Also added 'failover_state=true' tag to alerts created during this window.

priya: recommendation for alert tuning post-incident:
- extend p99 alert evaluation window in eu regions from 5m -> 10m
- add composite alert: p99 > 700ms AND pod_restarts_rate > 5% OR kv_hit_rate < 75% (to reduce noise)
- separate 'deploy-related' vs 'infra-related' annotations on alerts

paul: opened INC ticket INC-2026-2155667890 in JIRA, assigned to eng-sre for RCA and to product for deployment policy review. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2026-2155667890

nate: handoff: I'll be on-call for another 20m then hand to tom at 21:30 UTC. tom, watch for reversion when we remove suppressions. If p99 climbs above 700ms for 10m or customer reports increase, escalate to capacity team.

tom: ack. I'll monitor dashboards. Quick followups: can we add a 'multi-region-failover' state panel to main console and make failover_state label part of alert payloads? reduces ambiguity during incidents.

emily: noted. I'll open PR to add panel + metadata to alerts and dashboards. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure-monitoring/pull/357

priya: post-incident action items for RCA:
1) investigate restart cause for pods (OOM? liveness probe?)
2) examine why autoscaler didn't trigger
3) improve cache-priming during fractional failover (test harness)
4) implement composite alerts and longer evaluation windows for region p99s

paul: customer comms: I'll draft a follow-up email for cust-C and cust-D and coordinate with account teams. We should avoid language implying data loss.

nate: quick note on noise: the 'p50 cache-miss' alerts were spamming ops channel — suppressing them during failover windows and making a composite alert will cut noise substantially. Good for oncall burnout.

tom: we should also add runbook step: prefer fractional/fanout failover before full regional cutover; include TTL for suppression and explicit commands to lift them. I'll add to runbook after handoff.

ops-bot: automated update: fractional failover at 25% remains active. cache-warm job cw-2155668160 completed successfully.

nate: handing off now to tom. final: monitor p99, kv_hit_rate, pod_restarts; ensure suppressions expire as scheduled. If anything odd, @tom escalate. Handoff timestamp: 2155669200.

tom: taking over. thanks all. I'll keep the thread updated and follow up on PRs and RCA items.
